name: Self-Hosted Release 2.2.9
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(byok): give a second OpenAI-compatible endpoint its own key by @jairo-litman in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2290
* fix(code-review): evaluate context-needing Kody Rules on Azure Repos by @jairo-litman in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2311
* fix(mcp): carry proactive hints in tool _meta so offers reach the prompt by @jairo-litman in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2248
* docs: consolidate LLM provider pages into cookbook by @edvaldofreitas in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2292
* docs(custom-agents): rename page to Overview, drop beta tag from subpages by @edvaldofreitas in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2285
* docs(auto-approve): give automatic approval its own page in all five languages by @malinosqui in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2315
* fix(llm): read Z.AI's weekly/monthly limit as a spent quota by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2254
* fix(notifications): honor API_SMTP_FROM as SMTP sender by @alexurpi in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2241
* fix(business-rules): read a GitLab work item URL as its issue (#2280) by @andyst-dev in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2283
* fix(llm): repair an invalid escape before dropping a reroute-json reply by @andyst-dev in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2260
* feat(signup): record first-touch attribution on new organizations by @malinosqui in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2305
* fix(code-review): stop false incompletes in custom agents by @Wellington01 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2307
* fix(code-review): keep committed secret files out of the agent tools by @Wellington01 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2310
* fix: production error triage 2026-10-29 by @Wellington01 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2314
* docs(gitlab): document group access tokens and token rotation by @malinosqui in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2336
* fix(web): show the API's message when a BYOK test or save is rejected by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2332
* fix(centralized-config): resolve repository folders whose name contains a slash by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2282
* fix(code-review): review the PR when a push removes a reviewed change by @andyst-dev in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2320
* docs: add changelog entry for Oct 22-30 by @edvaldofreitas in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2322
* fix(agents): strip leading slash from conversation sandbox tool paths by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2323
* fix(review): drop prose-recovered findings that name no changed file by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2300
* fix(llm): drop retired Gemini 2.5 models from the Vertex curated catalog by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2337
* feat(review): lean finder with embedded verify, dedup and enrichment by @sartorijr92 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2284
* fix(llm): retry a one-shot 429 once, then hand it to the BYOK fallback by @sartorijr92 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2345
* fix(llm): hand a 429 met on the transient re-issue to the fallback by @sartorijr92 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2348
* fix: bring the 2.2.10 security hotfix to main by @Wellington01 in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2352

## New Contributors
* @alexurpi made their first contribution in https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/pull/2241

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/compare/2.2.9...selfhosted-2.2.9
